active.description: `false` deactivates the account and ends its sessions.

primary_address.description: An alias of the account that becomes its login name; the former one stays as an alias.

address.description: The login name: the primary address, else the username, else the contact address.

drive.description: A drive (RFC 0005, 12): a file store of the tenant; nobody logs in as it.

native.description: Has an address of the tenant (RFC 0003, 1); only such an account can have mail.

shared.description: A shared mailbox (RFC 0002, 12.1): nobody logs in as it.

name.description: The script that runs; null for none.

primary.description: The primary address – the login name; the others are aliases.

cookie.description: For a login in a browser: keep the session in an HttpOnly cookie instead of answering with the token.

credential.description: What the browser returned, as JSON.

lifetime_seconds.description: For a login: how long the session lasts; 8 hours if left out.

name.description: For a registration: a name for the passkey, e.g. the device.

password.description: The app password – shown this once.

name.description: Which device or program it is for, e.g. "Thunderbird at home".

project.description: Move it to another project of the tenant.

client_secret.description: For a confidential application: its secret, shown this once.

AssignmentView.description: A role assignment or authorization: who holds which role.

creator.description: An account id, `system`, `operator` or a service.

application.description: The name of the application asking.

max_age.description: The session may be at most this many seconds old.

prompt.description: `none`, `login`, `consent`, `select_account` – what the login UI must respect.

AuthorizationView.description: A project role held by an account or group.

tenant.description: The tenant that gave it: the project's own, or one it is granted to.

challenge_id.description: Send it back with the answer.

verified.description: Verified addresses log in and are unique in the instance.

not the address, so others failing on purpose do not lock the account out here.

lifetime_seconds.description: How long the session lasts; 8 hours if left out, at most 30 days.

selector.description: The new key's selector: its record belongs at `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>`; `mail-dns` shows it.

oneOf.description: For a domain not verified yet: the TXT record that proves it.

cookie.description: For browsers: keep the session in an HttpOnly cookie instead of answering with the token.

lifetime_seconds.description: How long the session lasts; 8 hours if left out.

required.description: The tenant requires a second factor.

setup_due.description: The account has none yet and may log in without one until then (the tenant's grace period).

node.description: A directory of the account; leave out for the whole store.

rights.description: Letters of `randws`: read, add, rename, delete, write content, share.

issuer.description: OpenID Connect: the issuer. SAML: the provider's entity ID.

register.description: Offered to everyone on the login page; creates accounts where the tenant allows registration (RFC 0003).
